preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1) if (count := s[i:j].count('1')) > 0 and (j - i) % count == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings of s that contain at least one '1' and whose length is divisible by the number of '1's in that substring.
